symptom: The captured canvas snapshot flow hangs after execution because the renderer remains queued instead of observing the terminal result.
direct_cause: A stale full snapshot returned by enqueue is applied after newer host patches have already advanced the renderer projection.
class_root: Projection snapshots must be monotonic by hostRevision so asynchronous command responses cannot roll state backward over newer patches.
affected_population: Project Agent canvas and non-canvas surfaces using command snapshots
Any enqueue, approval, stop, or future command racing with host patch delivery
internal_only_reason: The invariant is Nomi's renderer projection ordering contract; no third-party dependency controls it.
invariants: A snapshot with a lower hostRevision than the installed projection is ignored.
Only snapshots with the current project binding can update the projection.
generality_proof: Every command response that calls applySnapshot shares the projection store, while patches advance hostRevision through applyPatch; a monotonic guard at applySnapshot covers all command types and surfaces.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject stale or foreign full snapshots before they can overwrite the renderer projection.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: applyPatch is the newer-state producer and advances hostRevision used by the snapshot ordering guard.
enqueue, proposal decision, and stop command responses all converge on applySnapshot.

recurrence.reason: The asynchronous command/patch race is independent of surface identity and can recur for every command returning an older snapshot.
same_class_scan: Checked projectAgentTurnCommands enqueue/decide/stop callers and the host patch publication path.

prevention.invariant: Full snapshots may not decrease the installed hostRevision for the same binding.
prevention.failure_mode: Stale snapshots are ignored and the current projection remains available for the caller to observe or refresh.
prevention.strategy: Enforce revision ordering at the first shared renderer write boundary instead of adding timing assumptions to individual surfaces or tests.

legacy_paths.rationale: No obsolete projection path is being removed; all existing callers remain on the canonical store.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The race is caused by application event ordering, not a dependency version.

migration: No persisted data migration is needed; the guard applies to live renderer snapshots.
residual_risks: A binding reset still requires the existing subscription lifecycle to install a fresh snapshot.
